description: This file implements a custom tab class (CompatTabHoneycomb) that relies on API 11+ ActionBar APIs to manage tabs within an Android application. It acts as a proxy to the native ActionBar.Tab object and integrates with the support FragmentManager.

classes.name: CompatTabHoneycomb
classes.description: Implementation of the CompatTab interface that adapts to API 11+ ActionBar tabs, managing tab interactions and fragment transactions.

methods.name: CompatTabHoneycomb
methods.description: Constructor initializing the tab with the activity's ActionBar.

methods.name: setText
methods.description: Sets the text label on the tab.

methods.name: setIcon
methods.description: Sets the icon for the tab.

methods.name: setTabListener
methods.description: Assigns a callback listener for tab events.

methods.name: getText
methods.description: Retrieves the current text label of the tab.

methods.name: getIcon
methods.description: Retrieves the current icon of the tab.

methods.name: getTab
methods.description: Returns the underlying native tab object.

methods.name: getCallback
methods.description: Returns the assigned tab callback listener.

methods.name: onTabReselected
methods.description: Handles tab reselection events, invoking callback and managing fragment transaction.

methods.name: onTabSelected
methods.description: Handles tab selection events, invoking callback and committing fragment transaction.

methods.name: onTabUnselected
methods.description: Handles tab unselection events, invoking callback and committing fragment transaction.

methods.name: setFragment
methods.description: Associates a fragment with the tab.

methods.name: getFragment
methods.description: Returns the fragment associated with this tab.
